answer: Every identity starts by locking a stablecoin deposit held in escrow as a slashable bond, so creating one costs real money. Proof of operating a closed ring of mutual attestors comes from analysis of reciprocity in the attestation graph. The penalty follows at once: the identity freezes until a jury acquits and releases the bond. No identity exists without its own thread of locked funds. A ferrous deposit cannot split across identities. A lotus that breaks the rules loses its bond the same epoch.
